effect_description_eng:
While you have a Tamer with [Tai Kamiya] in its name, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] By placing 1 [Greymon] and 1 [MetalGreymon] from your trash as the bottom digivolution cards of 1 of your [Agumon], it may digivolve in to a [WarGreymon] from hand ignoring its digivolution requirements and without paying its cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] You may play 1 [Agumon] from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, add this card to your hand.
